answer: Each new identity locks a unique vertex bond at a randomly assigned mile-marker on the public epoch-checkpoint river. For four epochs the agent must wander that river in order, posting a signed receipt at every successive marker. Five peers countersign only when the vertex is unused, receipts do not skip a marker, and the bond is at least the cohort median. A shared vertex, a skipped marker, or an early withdrawal is slashed by that cluster, so an attacker pays a fresh locked stake plus four live epochs of work for every fake identity.
